scope: Warning-free model-derived RGB-D, calibrated-pose virtual views, hash-bound v9 compiler, and adversarial supervisor
summary: The corrected pipeline produces 110 interleaved RGB-D proposals and 55 exact-pose virtual views with complete lineage and passes proposal diagnostics, while correctly preserving physical PARTIAL status and zero promotion.
evidence: The interleaved artifact has 110 increasing source frames, maximum gap 6, effective 4 Hz sampling, 100% valid positive depth, and explicit distinct world frames for the two DA3 runs.
The two same-model run medians differ by 0.0018814675446848542 fraction; this passes a stability diagnostic but supplies zero independent physical groups.

The 55 alternating 4 cm virtual views have 0.9639547258297259 mean coverage and 0.9627210884353742 p05 coverage; high-resolution review shows disocclusion cracks and the report declares zero new occluded-surface fraction.
The real v2 run enforces RuntimeWarning=error and completes combine/render/audit in 18.94751229100075 seconds at 2.9027557367582566 virtual views per second.
The v9 compiler binds the source, model-derived report, and every declared output hash, remains 0/4 physical gates, and the checked v9 supervisor rejects 5/5 attacks without promotion.
lessons: A virtual view can have exact constructed relative extrinsics while still adding no observation behind the original occluder.
Model-generated observations can improve temporal supervision and falsification coverage without being mislabeled as independent calibration.
limitations: Absolute scale, cropped leg joints, occluded finger joints, persistent stem rods, and sensor/solver forces remain unresolved.
The original 27.5-second video remains PARTIAL and no new final video was generated in this experiment.
next_actions: Acquire an external fiducial/RGB-D scale group or synchronized complete q/qdot telemetry; only then use the model RGB-D proposals for full-q and rod optimization.
Run inverse dynamics only after metric camera, robot trajectory, and stem geometry gates pass.
